subject: Follow-up: 4 open action items (2 overdue)
body:
Hi Gaurav,

Here is a quick follow-up on your open action items from recent meetings.

Overdue:
- Review the parsing rules for owners and due dates (was due Fri 20 Nov, from actiontrack kickoff on Tue 10 Nov; actiontrack weekly sync on Tue 17 Nov)
- Agree on the demo script (was due Fri 20 Nov, from actiontrack kickoff on Tue 10 Nov)

Upcoming:
- Add edge-case notes to the test fixtures (due Sat 28 Nov, from actiontrack weekly sync on Tue 17 Nov)
- Prepare the demo dataset (due Tue 1 Dec, from Demo prep on Mon 23 Nov)

Could you reply with a quick status or a new date for each? Let me know if anything is blocked.

Thanks,
